title: Account security PHPUnit matrix
summary: Adds a focused PHPUnit account-security matrix that covers the Account security checklist: username and password hardening, verification gates, step-up protected changes, TOTP and passkey factories, branded security mail assertions, and Cloudron OIDC no-local-reset regression.
changes: Add tests/Feature/AccountSecurity matrix suites for epic checklist coverage.
Extend User factory with withTotp, withPasskey, and withoutMfa states for local MFA fixtures.
Assert Cloudron OIDC and directory identities cannot use local password reset or enrol MFA.
Mail-fake coverage for the branded auth and security-event notification kit.
Mark Account security / v0.39.x as the completed line in AGENTS.md.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.39.x Account security line: closing matrix (#234) after passkeys (0.39.6).
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Deep behavioural coverage for each child remains in tests/Feature/Auth; the matrix asserts cross-cutting checklist cohesion.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Tests and documentation-only changes do not alter runtime auth behaviour.
provenance: Issue #234; pull request #329; closes epic #225 and milestone 5 after deploy.
